sections.strategic_report: strategic report for the year ended 30 April 2025. Review of the business The results for the year under review and the financial position at the year end were considered satisfactory by the directors. The group continues to pursue organic growth in line with its underwriting strategy and risk appetite . As shown in the group 's profit and loss account set out on page 9 , the group made a profit after tax of £ 1 , 993 , 743 (2024: £1,7 43 , 791 ). The group 's balance sheet on page 1 1 shows that its financial position remains strong with net assets valued at £4,02 5 , 166 (2024: £3,4 81 , 423 ). Key performance indicators The management monitors progress on the overall group strategy and the individual strategic elements by reference to a number of key performance indicators. The key financial performance indicators of the group are : Gross Written Premium Coverholder Commission income Underwriting profitability Operating cost ratio Cash collection and debtor ageing The key non-financial performance indicators are the number of policies underwritten which reflects underwriting activity, portfolio growth and diversification. Other performance indicators The management of the business and the execution of the group 's strategy are subject to a number of risks. Risks are reviewed by the management and the appropriate processes put in place to monitor and mitigate them. The key business risks affecting the group are set out below:- Customers The group operates in a competitive insurance market and is committed to delivering fair value and appropriate customer outcomes. Management places emphasis on: Product governance and oversight Accurate and timely policy administration Ongoing monitoring of underwriting performance Use of systems and data to support oversight and control Customer and broker relationships are reviewed regularly to ensure service quality and compliance with regulatory requirements. Employees The group 's performance depends largely on its staff. The resignation of key individuals and the inability to recruit people with the right experience and skills could adversely impact the group 's results. To mitigate these issues, the company maintains open lines of communication for all staff, to maintain high service levels and have a number of schemes linked to the group 's results that are designed to reward and retain key individuals. SALAMANDER HOLDINGS LIMITED
